desc: The Xeno Flash Hider works superbly as a stand alone muzzle device, but really shines when paired with a Xeno Adapter equipped suppressor. The Xeno Flash Hider gives you a lightweight suppressor mounting option with non-negotiable repeatability and a solid return to zero — ideal for precision-minded shooters. Don’t worry, the Xeno Mount System still provides you, hard core users, the durability you’ve come to expect from Dead Air.
